implementation.e_aurc_oracle: every correct patch ranked above every error with no ties (each patch its own block), then the §7.1 rule; a binary oracle score would make all errors one tie block, which the §7.1 interpolation scores at r²/2, below any tie-free ranking
implementation.err_auroc: AUROC of the confidence score, positive = correct prediction, ties count ½ (Mann-Whitney, average ranks)
implementation.image_level: I_f = images with ≥1 patch in test fold f; image error = ≥1 tooth misclassified; image accepted at τ iff its minimum tooth score ≥ τ (same τ as tooth level, from 05); the image risk-coverage curve (OracleCov) ranks images by that minimum with the §7.1 rule
implementation.empty_accept: risk of an empty accepted set is NaN and is counted; a macro-average over a NaN fold is NaN
implementation.assertion_5_5: inversions = pairs with S_i < S_j and R_1,i > R_1,j over the whole test fold; new ties = pairs with S_i ≠ S_j and R_1,i = R_1,j; attribution: AURC of R_1 with its ties broken by S must equal AURC(MSP) exactly; any failure stops the script
implementation.pooled_7_6: test rows of rounds 1-5 (each patch once) with the 05 norm_* scores; Periapical subgroup = reference label; sanity check = pooled AURC(gate_a1) − pooled AURC(msp)
implementation.decile_7_5: rank pooled patches by norm_msp (= normalised Φ_S); top decile = first ⌊N/10⌋, a tie block straddling the boundary kept whole; AUROC of norm_maha (= normalised Φ_M), positive = correct; reported with n and error count; estimability decided in 07 by the §8.1 >5% degenerate rule
implementation.diag_10_3: per test fold: OLS of g(x) (raw maha) on log(crop_area) (original crop area from 01's manifest) -> slope, R²; Spearman ρ(g, crop_area); crop-area tertile AURC for every method ALWAYS reported (the plan does not quantify 'strong'); tertile cut points from all patches' crop areas (covariate only), numpy linear quantiles
implementation.diag_10_4: number of distinct float64 test-fold scores per method per fold
implementation.spearman: Spearman ρ(Φ_S, Φ_M) per test fold, descriptive (§7.5)
implementation.class_balanced: w_i = 1/(K·n_{y_i,f}) with n from the test fold; coverage unweighted (§7.4.2)
implementation.three_class: test rows with reference label ≠ Impacted; error = prediction ≠ label incl. predicted Impacted; τ, α*, Φ unchanged from the 4-class fits (§7.4.1)
implementation.single_round: §9.2/§9.3 ablations and Deep Ensembles: the same per-fold functions on the round-1 test fold F1 only, reported as a single CV round
